manifest.description: Infer missing Java production seams from test pain such as reflection, widened visibility, and long mock setup.
when_to_use: tests use reflection, VisibleForTesting, test-only DI overrides, excessive mocks, or helpers to reach production behavior
mechanical test smells exist but the missing production seam requires semantic judgment
a correction plan needs extraction or adapter slices that make tests direct
anti_patterns: do not use for simple flaky tests or assertion cleanup
do not use when the desired seam is already explicitly declared
do not use on non-Java targets
